observations: Three photos show a white console with a perforated right side and a black left side, with a white controller in front.
The console has a small 'X' logo on the bottom right corner and a small 'X' logo on the top left corner.
The controller has the standard Xbox layout: D-pad, two analog sticks, four colored buttons (Y, X, B, A), and the Xbox logo.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The controller shows minor scuffs and wear, especially on the grips and around the buttons.
No games, discs, or cables are visible in any photo.
The seller claims 'No games' and 'Working perfectly', 'No single fault'.

claims.evidence: No games, discs, or game cases are visible in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
No video or screenshot of the console powering on, showing the dashboard, or playing a game. The condition appears clean, but functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.
No close-up shots of the console's ports, power button, or internal components. No evidence of internal damage or software issues.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional (e.g., no power, no HDMI output, no internet connectivity)
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, showing the dashboard, and playing a game or connected to a TV.

risks.risk: Controller may have internal damage or battery issues
risks.proof: Close-up of the controller's ports, battery compartment, and a video of it connecting to the console and responding to inputs.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number on the back of the console and a video of the console's system settings showing the model number.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and showing the dashboard.
Video of the console playing a game or connected to a TV.
Close-up photo of the serial number on the back of the console.
Close-up of the controller's ports and battery compartment.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
